observation: Front, top and iso inspected together as one contact sheet at 500 px a view. Square flange over a sunken spigot, with two tall leaning flames at diagonally opposite corners and engraved hex granulation in the other two. Front view shows the spigot below the flange and both flames rooted on the flange, leaning outward from vertical; top view shows the flame bases wholly inside the flange corners and the granulation engraved rather than raised. Nothing floating, no flame overhanging the flange edge.
